verdict.rationale: gstack ships skills as plain SKILL.md files in a public GitHub repo, installed by git-clone-and-copy or symlinked into `.claude/skills/`. That means instructions and scripts are inspectable on disk before and after install, and the upgrade flow shows what's new. There is no dedicated review or preview feature, though; inspection relies on reading the cloned repo yourself. Missing for 10: a documented pre-install listing of the files and scripts a skill adds, a documented post-install file inventory or audit command, and hands-on corroboration of a review workflow.
